name: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. II Unit
summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. II functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed with the explicit aim of completing a business combination, such as a merger, acquisition of assets, or share exchange, with one or more existing operational businesses. Its investment units typically bundle one Class A ordinary share with a fractional redeemable warrant, the exact conditions of which are detailed in the company's official offering materials.
